records.name: LADEE laser communications experiment
records.availability: The spacecraft reached the lunar surface at the end of its mission. The measured rates describe the experiment.

claims.text: NASA measured a 622 Mbps optical downlink from lunar orbit and a 20 Mbps uplink from New Mexico to LADEE.
NASA confirmed the planned impact of the host spacecraft in April 2014.

records.name: Queqiao-2
records.availability: The cited mission reports establish service for named spacecraft. Current uptime, spare capacity and terms for another customer remain unverified.

claims.text: CNSA reported a 24-hour elliptical lunar orbit and a successful communications test with Chang’e-4 on the far side.
Queqiao-2 supported the Chang’e-6 landing on the lunar far side on 2 June 2024.

records.name: Lunar Pathfinder
records.availability: The published schedule depends on launch, lunar deployment and commissioning. Service entry and customer capacity remain unverified.

claims.text: ESA reported final environmental testing in the United Kingdom and a planned 2027 launch. The mission design calls for a relay in an elliptical lunar orbit, with LuSEE-Night among the intended users.
